scope: Bounded direct SQL evidence execution; local synthetic state, not HTTP or CPU model serving.

environment.database_version: PostgreSQL 16.15 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

aggregation: Pooled nearest-rank per-request percentiles; throughput=sum(requests)/sum(measured seconds), not mean of per-run throughput. No confidence interval from three short repeats.
